FINAL IVX DEEP QA + LIVE DEPLOYMENT PROOF

PRIORITY: P0
MODE: EXECUTE, REPAIR, DEPLOY, VERIFY
OBJECTIVE: Close all 20 verified IVX IA/autonomous defects and prove that every completed change is deployed live from the owner-controlled GitHub repository.

DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER GENERAL REPORT.
DO NOT CLAIM COMPLETION WITHOUT LIVE EVIDENCE.
DO NOT START NEW FEATURES.

==================================================
SECTION 1 — ESTABLISH THE CANONICAL BASELINE
==================================================

Use only:

Repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Production branch:
main

Production service:
Render service srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0

First obtain and return:

- authenticated GitHub main SHA
- clean-clone HEAD SHA
- CI-tested SHA
- Render deployment SHA
- /health SHA
- /version SHA
- current Render deployment ID
- production URL
- HTTP status for /health and /version

Required equality:

GitHub main SHA
=
clean-clone HEAD
=
CI-tested SHA
=
Render deployment SHA
=
/health SHA
=
/version SHA

If GitHub returns HTTP 401 or 404:

- repair the GitHub App/OAuth authentication context;
- verify repository access;
- verify Actions read/write access;
- do not continue using an unauthenticated local checkout;
- return the exact owner action only if Rork cannot restore access.

==================================================
SECTION 2 — CLOSE CRITICAL/HIGH DEFECTS 1–10
==================================================

Fix each defect separately with one branch and one PR.

1. DIRECT GITHUB-TO-MAIN WRITE
- Reject all direct writes to main.
- Reject Git Data API writes targeting main.
- Require branch → PR → CI → merge.

2. OVERRIDABLE TARGET BRANCH
- Remove unsafe GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH and branchOverride behavior from autonomous production jobs.
- Production target must resolve only to main.
- Reject unknown or alternate branches.

3. RENDER DEPLOYMENT WITHOUT ID
- Remove success fallback based only on a commit.
- Deployment requires a real Render deployment ID.
- No deployment ID = FAILED_DEPLOYMENT.

4. SYSTEM MODE BYPASS
- systemMode must not bypass normal patch, CI, approval, deployment, or verification gates.

5. IMPLICIT EXECUTION PHRASES
- “Do it now,” “hazlo ahora,” and similar phrases must create an explicit approval request.
- They must not immediately enqueue destructive or production work.

6. ATTACH REQUEST LOSS
- A new incoming owner request must create a new job.
- It must not overwrite or reuse the currently active job unless the owner explicitly selects resume.

7. DUPLICATE EVIDENCE
- Duplicate evidence must not create duplicate jobs.
- Enforce idempotency by request ID, trace ID, and evidence hash.

8. CANCELLED JOB INTEGRITY
- Cancelled jobs must remain CANCELLED.
- They must never produce FAILED, COMPLETED, or contradictory status records.

9. RESUME APPROVAL VALIDATION
- Revalidate approval token, expiration, scope, owner, branch, and requested action before resuming.

10. CONVERSATION WRITE RACE
- Make conversation-state writes atomic.
- Prevent concurrent owner messages from overwriting actions or state.

For each defect return:

- defect number
- file
- function
- root cause
- branch
- commit SHA
- PR URL
- tests added
- CI run ID
- PASS/FAIL

==================================================
SECTION 3 — CLOSE RELIABILITY/TRUTHFULNESS DEFECTS
==================================================

11. ATOMIC CONVERSATION STATE
- Use durable transactional or versioned writes.
- Test crash during write and restart recovery.

12. RESTART-SAFE FALLBACK
- Remove ephemeral local-file state as authoritative production state.
- Durable store must be authoritative.
- Local cache may be read-only fallback only.

13. CAPABILITY CLAIMS
- IVX IA must claim GitHub, CI, Render, or deployment capability only after a successful live capability probe.
- Current unavailable capability must be reported as unavailable.

14. MULTI-TURN QA TEST
- Replace non-empty-output checks with exact intent-retention and action-state assertions.

15. APPROVAL-FLOW QA
- Add a complete test:
  request → approval required → owner approval → execution → evidence.

16. ZOMBIE DETECTION
- Include COMMITTING, PUSHING, CI_RUNNING, DEPLOYING, and VERIFYING stages.
- Test stale heartbeat recovery in each stage.

17. STALE BOOT CHECK
- Do not fail healthy long-running deployments only because they are older than 24 hours.
- Validate live health, deployment status, and SHA instead.

18. PRIVATE GITHUB SHA PARITY
- Use authenticated GitHub access.
- Do not classify the service unhealthy because an anonymous GitHub request returns 404.

19. OWNER TOKEN CONSISTENCY
- Standardize one test-only owner authentication mechanism.
- Remove inconsistent IVX_OWNER_TOKEN vs automated owner-path behavior.

20. REMOVE EMERGENCY HARD-CODED OWNER LOGIN
- Remove hard-coded recovery credentials from QA and evidence generation.
- Use protected CI secrets or isolated test identities.
- Scan repository and history for exposed credentials.

==================================================
SECTION 4 — VALIDATION
==================================================

After repairing all 20 defects, run:

- TypeScript
- lint
- unit tests
- integration tests
- IVX CI
- IVX QA Suite
- IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
- Android Emulator QA
- iOS Simulator QA
- secret scan
- dependency audit
- owner-auth acceptance
- autonomous-worker restart recovery
- cancellation and resume tests
- duplicate-request tests
- deployment verification tests

Required:

- all required jobs execute on real runners;
- no skipped critical tests;
- no anonymous GitHub verification;
- no production tests using hard-coded credentials;
- three consecutive PASS runs for the five required workflows.

==================================================
SECTION 5 — REAL LIVE DEPLOYMENT PROOF
==================================================

After CI passes:

1. Merge approved repair PRs into main.
2. Record the resulting GitHub main SHA.
3. Trigger Render deployment.
4. Capture the real deployment ID.
5. Wait until Render reports LIVE.
6. Call /health.
7. Call /version.
8. Verify the repaired owner/autonomous endpoints.
9. Run production smoke tests.
10. Confirm no rollback is required.

Required equality:

GitHub main SHA
=
CI-tested SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
/health SHA
=
/version SHA

Return:

- repository
- branch
- merged PRs
- GitHub main SHA
- CI workflow names and run IDs
- CI-tested SHA
- Render service ID
- Render deployment ID
- Render deployed SHA
- deployment status
- /health status and SHA
- /version status and SHA
- boot time
- production URLs
- smoke-test results
- completion timestamp

==================================================
SECTION 6 — PROVE AUTONOMOUS END TO END
==================================================

Run one safe owner-authorized engineering task through IVX IA:

Task:
Add one harmless owner-only diagnostic field to the production health response.

Autonomous must complete:

request
→ classify engineering intent
→ create job
→ create branch
→ inspect files
→ modify code
→ add test
→ run tests
→ commit
→ push
→ open PR
→ CI PASS
→ approval
→ merge
→ Render deployment
→ /health verification
→ /version verification
→ SHA parity
→ evidence ledger
→ truthful final result

Required evidence:

- owner approval ID
- job ID
- trace ID
- branch
- files changed
- commit SHA
- remote SHA
- PR URL
- CI run ID
- merge SHA
- Render deployment ID
- /health result
- /version result
- production SHA
- timestamp

The job must not be marked COMPLETED unless every item exists.

==================================================
FINAL RESULT
==================================================

Return exactly one:

IVX_AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_VERIFIED

or

IVX_AUTONOMOUS_NOT_VERIFIED

IVX_AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_VERIFIED requires:

- all 20 defects fixed;
- tests added;
- all required workflows green;
- three consecutive workflow passes;
- authenticated GitHub evidence;
- main is the only production source;
- real Render deployment ID;
- complete SHA parity;
- one full owner-authorized autonomous task deployed and verified;
- no hard-coded owner credentials;
- no direct main-write path;
- no false COMPLETED status.

If NOT VERIFIED, return only the remaining blockers with:

- defect number
- file
- function
- exact error
- owner action required
- evidence

START WITH DEFECT 1.
COMPLETE DEFECTS ONE BY ONE.
DO NOT SKIP TO CERTIFICATION.
